text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"That" expires today. Neither of us looked 
like we could make it, so... this is a 
huge help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the student who happened to be there 
gave me two free tickets to the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing! A gift to repay me for the 
sushi the other day?! You truly are 
earnest to a fault!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Proposal ACCEPTED! Are you prepared to 
commune with the animals? And prepared to 
purchase souvenirs for the girl who 
bestowed the tickets upon us?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let us depart, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaaaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moooorning~~

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm sorry for startling you. It 
seems Hanako-chan has taken quite a liking 
to you, miss.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine... Sorry, Mr. Cow. Did my loud 
voice startle you...?

text_block_list.name: Cow (Hanako)
text_block_list.text: Moooorning~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my my...! The little sister hid behind 
her big brother's back, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my my...! The little sister hid behind 
her big sister's back, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to throw 
cold water on such a wonderful memory with 
your brother...

text_block_list.name: Zoo Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to throw 
cold water on such a wonderful memory with 
your sister...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
N-No need to worry! Neither the lady nor 
the cow is at fault! It's just—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. Could you touch the cow first? 
I'd like... an example.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prioritizing her request, I pat the cow's 
head. Chairwoman Akikawa immediately 
begins mimicking me, starting her own 
mental visualization of petting a cow.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Nice one! Trainer <username>, you're a natural at 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, can you show me the example 
again? This time, I want to say hello to 
the tiger!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Apparently tigers greet each other 
with soft chuffs and snorts... Yet 
whenever I try alone, I am ignored every 
time!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tiger-sa~n... Hmph-hmph, tee-hee...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
T-Tiger-san? Why are you turning away? 
We're over here, you know? Tiger-sa~n...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside Chairwoman Akikawa, we 
gave our all playing with the animals—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Phew…… Next is the "Bunny House"…… umm……
choice_data_list:
M-Madam Chairwoman? Aren't you getting 
tired...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! I-I can still keep going. I 
haven't even... gone to the... 'Fluffy 
Sheep Corner'... yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, her voice lacked the vigor it had 
just a moment ago. Chairwoman Akikawa 
takes shorter strides, so walking must be 
twice as exhausting for her.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
........I can still keep going. 
................

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa hung her head and 
stopped in her tracks. ……Looking just like 
a young child.
choice_data_list:
...You just want to see a little bit more, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—! Did you say yes?! You said it! Alright, 
deal! We're doing it, got it?! Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With sparkling eyes, Chairwoman Akikawa 
hopped around with joy. To fulfill her 
wishes, I decided to spread out the zoo 
map once more.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A blind spot! To think there was a 
sightseeing bus!
choice_data_list: We'll be able to visit them all like this.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: !! I see! I see, I see! ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget to buy some souvenirs on the 
way back! I truly have to thank the girl 
who gave me the ticket.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Are you sure? Is it really okay 
for me to take a souvenir?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sorry you had to cover for me too, 
Chairwoman! So, how was the zoo? Did ya 
have fun?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice! Immensely so!! Isn't that right, 
Trainer <username>!
